inlines.v: ADJU'DICATE, verb transitive [Latin adjudico, to give sentence. See Judge.] To adjudge; to try and determine, as a court. it has the sense of adjudge. ADJU'DICATE, verb intransitive To try and determine judicially; as, the court adjudicated upon the case.
